value.body: The Remount and Veterinary Corps (RVC) is the Army's veterinary arm. It looks after the animals the Army uses — horses, mules and dogs — and runs breeding, training and veterinary hospitals. BVSc graduates can join as commissioned officers through a Short Service Commission in the RVC.

items.label: Posts in a recent notification
items.source: Indian Army 95th SSC RVC notification (as reported)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A BVSc or BVSc & AH degree with internship completed, Indian citizenship and the age limit. Applications are screened by the Directorate General Remount Veterinary Services; shortlisted candidates attend an SSB interview and a medical examination. Notifications appear on the official Join Indian Army website.

value.title: At a glance
items: Intake is small — usually a few dozen or fewer posts per notification.
Permanent commission is possible through a departmental test, with an age condition at the time of commission.
Service involves postings across the country, including field and remote areas.
Military service conditions — fixed tenure, transfers, discipline — differ from civilian veterinary work.
